stages.title: Brief
stages.instructions: Turn the request into a content brief with clara_criteria. Include audience, tone, length, and the call to action. Every criterion needs a human_gate or an artifact reference.

stages.title: Draft
stages.instructions: Write the draft from the approved brief. Record the copy and its word count as evidence.

stages.title: Edit
stages.instructions: Edit the draft against the brief. Record the final copy and a short change summary.

stages.title: Deliver
stages.instructions: Deliver the final copy. Record the result and any artifact paths or URLs, then complete the request.
